svg.title: The 840-point start of the search: two flexible blocks, 720 fixed bridges, one extra point
svg.desc: Every cap is one of the 840 points. Centre: 720 bridge points in 45 tiles of 16, one row per colour class of K6. Left and right: the two 60-point blocks, each 12 axial points and a 48-system in three layers. Top: the 841st starting point, with lines to the 47 points it overlaps at the start.
